description: This Java source file defines the SniHandler class, which extends Netty's AbstractSniHandler to handle SSL/TLS Server Name Indication (SNI) processing, including SSL context lookup, handler replacement, client certificate retrieval, and ALPN protocol detection within a mock server environment.

classes.name: SniHandler
classes.description: Handles SSL/TLS SNI processing, including SSL context lookup, handler replacement, client certificate extraction, and ALPN protocol detection within a Netty-based mock server.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs SSL context lookup based on hostname, adding it to configuration if not blank.

methods.name: onLookupComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of SSL context lookup, replacing handler or throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: replaceHandler
methods.description: Replaces the current Netty handler with a new SslHandler using the provided SSL context.

methods.name: retrieveClientCertificates
methods.description: Retrieves client SSL certificates from the SSL session or channel attributes, with logging if no certificates are available.

methods.name: getALPNProtocol
methods.description: Detects the negotiated ALPN protocol (HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2) from the SSL handler or channel attributes, with error handling and logging.
